bitwarden_settings.title: Bitwarden for network logins
bitwarden_settings.description: Install the official Bitwarden extension to fill sign-in forms displayed inside CommunityGlows.
bitwarden_settings.local_only: The archive stays on this computer. It is never uploaded to CommunityGlows, and we never access your vault or filled fields.
bitwarden_settings.step_download: Open the official releases page and download the dist-chrome-*.zip asset from the latest Browser release.
bitwarden_settings.step_choose: Return here and select that archive with “Import extension”.
bitwarden_settings.step_restart: Restart CommunityGlows to load Bitwarden in network pages.
bitwarden_settings.restart_required: The change will apply after restart. Your network sessions are preserved.
bitwarden_settings.developer_managed: This installation is controlled by the Windows development configuration. Remove that configuration before replacing it here.
bitwarden_settings.status_error: CommunityGlows could not check Bitwarden. Close and reopen Settings to try again.
bitwarden_settings.download_error: The official Bitwarden page could not be opened.
bitwarden_settings.import_error: This archive could not be installed. Make sure it is the official dist-chrome-*.zip file.
bitwarden_settings.restart_error: CommunityGlows could not restart automatically. Close and reopen the application.

backup.inline_hint: Export or restore your cookies and local sessions when moving to another device.
backup.info_text: Your profiles, settings, and accounts are automatically synced via the cloud — they follow you across all your devices. Only session cookies (which keep you logged into social networks) cannot be synced: browsers forbid transferring them to third-party servers. To transfer your logged-in sessions to a new device, use the encrypted export below.
backup.export_hint: Choose a password to encrypt your cookies and profiles.
backup.import_hint: Enter the password used during export.
backup.export_step_1: Transfer the .sfbak file to your other device
backup.export_step_2: Install CommunityGlows on the new device
backup.export_step_3: Use "Restore a backup" with the same password
backup.export_tip: Keep your password safe — it is required to restore your data.
backup.import_done_message: All your profiles, accounts, and preferences have been restored.
backup.error_check_password: Is the password exactly the same as during export?
backup.error_check_file: Is the file a valid .sfbak backup?
backup.error_check_version: Was the backup created with a compatible version?
backup.error_invalid_file: This file does not appear to be a valid CommunityGlows backup.
